Perfect for those seeking specialty Arabica coffee online, Baarbara Washed AA offers a smooth, flavourful brew with the signature richness of Chikkamagaluru coffee beans.

Name: Flair Neo Flex with carrying case
Desc: The Flair NEO Flex is the ultimate entry point into manual espresso brewing, now upgraded for 2024 with a built-in pressure gauge and a no-preheat thin cylinder for an even smoother workflow. Perfect for beginners and experienced home baristas alike, this compact, lightweight espresso maker combines versatile brewing options with portability and durability. The high-strength polymer frame pairs with two portafilters: a Flow-Control portafilter ideal for beginners that simplifies pressure building, and a Bottomless 2-in-1 portafilter for advanced brewers seeking full control over extraction. Brew effortlessly at home or take it on the go—this is precision espresso made easy. The included dual-chamber carrying case features a foam divider for safe and organized storage, making travel effortless. Key Features Integrated Pressure Gauge: Provides real-time feedback for consistent shots within the optimal espresso brewing range. No-Preheat Thin Cylinder: Reduces thermal mass by 100 grams, eliminating the need to preheat and speeding up your workflow. Ultra-Light & Durable Build: High-strength polymer blend frame ensures portability without sacrificing durability. Two Portafilters Included: Flow-Control for beginners, enabling easy espresso brewing without dial-in. Bottomless 2-in-1 for advanced users, allowing precise control over extraction variables. Includes Dual-Chamber Travel Case: Foam divider provides secure storage for espresso maker and accessories. A safe, reliable setup that looks great on any countertop.

Name: Budan Black French Press | 600ml
Desc: The Budan Black French Press  is a sleek and durable coffee maker designed for enthusiasts seeking a rich and flavorful brew. Crafted with premium borosilicate glass and stainless steel accents, it offers both style and resilience. The dual mesh filtration system ensures a clean cup with minimal grinds, while the ergonomic handle and easy-pour spout enhance the user experience. With a 600 ml capacity, it's perfect for multiple servings, making it ideal for both personal use and entertaining guests. Its timeless design and robust construction make it a valuable addition to any coffee lover's collection.

Name: Classic French Press (600ml)
Desc: Every home-brewer's go-to equipment, the Classic French Press is known to make a consistent, heavy-bodied black coffee. Classic French Press features heat-resistant glass, stainless steel body and an easy to clean filter mesh. The filter mesh comes with a rubber lining to avoid breakage and brew a clean cup of coffee without any grounds. This equipment can brew up to 4 cups (600ml) of coffee.

Desc: We’re proud to offer our favorite coffee brewing machine! Brew American-style coffee or an espresso-style shot in just 1–2 minutes — perfect for lattes or cappuccinos. Name: Beveromatic Espresso Coffee Maker
Desc: The Beveromatic Coffee Maker brings café-quality beverages to your home with its professional-grade 20 bar pump system that extracts rich, aromatic espresso with a perfect crema layer. Powered by a robust 1500-watt heating element (Max rated power), this versatile machine heats up quickly and maintains optimal brewing temperature for consistently excellent results. The integrated milk steam wand allows you to create silky microfoam for lattes and cappuccinos, whilst the hot water function is perfect for Americanos or tea. With a generous 1.8-litre water tank, you can prepare multiple servings without constant refilling, making it ideal for entertaining guests or busy mornings. Whether you prefer a single or double shot of espresso, this coffee maker accommodates your needs with ease. The intuitive design ensures straightforward operation, allowing you to craft barista-style drinks including espresso, latte, and cappuccino in the comfort of your kitchen. Transform your daily coffee ritual into a premium experience with this feature-rich coffee maker that combines power, precision, and convenience.
